name: Mortal Kombat (1992) — Liu Kang Ending
notes: Primary arcade ending text preserved by Mortal Kombat Warehouse. It states that Liu Kang defeated Goro, ended Shang Tsung's rule over the tournament, and returned the contest to the Shaolin Temples. This slice does not treat the ending as sufficient by itself; later Original-continuity story/biography evidence is used to confirm the outcome.
